description: UKgrid is an R data package containing historical demand for the Great Britain National Grid. Its repository README describes half-hourly electricity demand and component series from April 2005 to October 2019, with helper functions for extracting and plotting the time series. Users load the package and select periods or demand components; outputs are demand values suitable for calibration or seasonal analysis. Geographic coverage is Great Britain, and the named period is historical, not a current live feed. The package DESCRIPTION states MIT terms with a copyright holder file. A limitation is that old system demand does not represent later electrification, embedded generation or future weather without adjustment. UKgrid can calibrate demand profiles in electricity dispatch and capacity simulations. The related catalogue ENTSO-E transparency data are a separate multinational source. No R package or demand time series was downloaded.
